introduction: The hub's audit package (internal/audit) serves agent sessions, token usage, cost, per-run audit records, transcripts, the unified audit query and the live SSE event stream. This spec lets members of a workspace's organization read all of these for that workspace, through hub's shared workspace access rule (wsaccess), while opening and completing sessions, reporting usage and ingesting audit data stay with the workspace's owner and admin tokens.

glossary.SQLite handle: The *sql.DB passed to the audit route registration functions (database.SqlDB in cmd/af-hub/main.go); nil in unit tests that register routes without SQLite.
glossary.bound PAT: A personal access token bound to exactly one workspace slug (spec 33); wsaccess.BoundSlug returns that slug.
glossary.ingestion routes: The eight audit POST routes of a workspace in internal/audit/handlers_audit.go that call checkWorkspaceAccess.
glossary.member: A caller whose UserID has a row in org_members for the org_id of the workspace and who is not its owner; wsaccess.AccessMember.
glossary.readable set: The result of wsaccess.ReadableSlugs(db, auth): every workspace slug of any status the caller may read, or all=true for an admin token; at most the bound slug for a bound PAT.
glossary.reader: A caller that wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(..., NeedRead) admits for a workspace: an admin token, the owner or a member.
glossary.refusal report: One call to the wsaccess bound-refusal observer made by wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace, carrying TokenID, UserID, BoundSlug, RequestedSlug, Method, Route template, Status and Surface (spec 34).
glossary.stranger: A caller that is not the workspace's owner, not a member of its org and not an admin token.

requirements.title: Per-run audit reads and the transcript
requirements.rationale: Members need to see what agents did on a workspace of their org, exactly as the owner does today.

criteria.condition: a caller holding audit:read requests any per-run read route for workspace W and the caller is an admin token, W's owner or a member of W's org
criteria.action: decide access by calling wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.SiteOf(c, 404)) and then wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.NeedRead), and serve the route as it serves the owner today
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the same body shape the owner receives for the same run

criteria.condition: a member requests a per-run read route for workspace W
criteria.action: serve the route without checking the workspace status
criteria.contract: HTTP 200

criteria.condition: the caller lacks the audit:read scope
criteria.action: refuse before any workspace lookup with today's scope refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with the unchanged audit:read scope message

criteria.condition: workspace W does not exist or the caller is a stranger to W
criteria.action: refuse without querying any audit rows
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"}

criteria.condition: a reader's per-run request passes the workspace check
criteria.action: apply the existing validations unchanged: the run_id format check, node_id is required on the transcript, and postmortem_not_found when no postmortem exists
criteria.contract: the same 400/404 status and error body the owner receives today for the same invalid input

criteria.condition: the per-run read routes are registered with a nil SQLite handle
criteria.action: skip the workspace check for every caller, as today

requirements.title: Single-workspace session and cost reads
requirements.rationale: Members get the session, usage and cost reads owners have, with the same active restriction and the same refusal shape.

criteria.condition: a caller holding sessions:read requests a session read route for a session or workspace in W, W has status active, and the caller is an admin token, W's owner or a member of W's org
criteria.action: decide access in hasWorkspaceAccess by calling wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.SiteOf(c, 403)), then wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.NeedRead), then requiring status active, and return W's data
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the session, usage list, cost summary or session list of W

criteria.condition: W does not exist, W is not active, the caller is a stranger to W, or W is outside a bound PAT's binding
criteria.action: refuse the session read route
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with body {error: "workspace access denied"}

criteria.condition: GET /sessions/:id or GET /sessions/:id/usage names a session id that does not exist
criteria.action: refuse before the workspace check
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "session not found"}

criteria.condition: the caller lacks the sessions:read scope
criteria.action: refuse before any session or workspace lookup with today's scope refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with the unchanged sessions:read scope message

criteria.condition: the session routes are registered with a nil SQLite handle
criteria.action: skip the workspace check on GET /sessions/:id and GET /sessions/:id/usage, and refuse GET /workspaces/:slug/cost for every non-admin caller, as today
criteria.contract: cost for a non-admin: HTTP 403 with body {error: "workspace access denied"}

requirements.title: Session list without a workspace
requirements.rationale: A member's session list shows the team's sessions next to the member's own without ever widening to workspaces the member may not read.

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller holding sessions:read requests GET /sessions without workspace_slug
criteria.action: build the restriction list in getAccessibleWorkspaces from wsaccess.ReadableSlugs, keeping only active workspaces, and list the sessions of every workspace in it with filters, ordering and cursors unchanged
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 listing the sessions of owned and member active workspaces

criteria.condition: the non-admin caller has no active readable workspace
criteria.action: pass a non-nil empty restriction list to Store.ListSessions
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with an empty session list

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller requests GET /sessions without workspace_slug
criteria.guard: the caller is a bound PAT
criteria.action: list at most the sessions of the bound workspace, and only when the token's user may read it and it is active
criteria.contract: HTTP 200; zero refusal reports

criteria.condition: an admin token requests GET /sessions without workspace_slug
criteria.action: list sessions of every workspace without restriction, as today
criteria.contract: HTTP 200

criteria.action: for any non-admin caller and any set of seeded workspaces, memberships and sessions, return from GET /sessions only sessions whose workspace is active and in the caller's readable set

requirements.title: Unified audit query
requirements.rationale: Members see the events of their org's workspaces in the unified audit query, while hub-wide events stay admin-only.

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller holding audit:read requests GET /audit
criteria.action: restrict the query to the events of every workspace in the caller's readable set from wsaccess.ReadableSlugs, of any status
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 listing events of owned and member workspaces

criteria.action: exclude hub events with an empty workspace from every GET /audit answer to a non-admin caller

criteria.condition: GET /audit carries a workspace filter naming a workspace outside the caller's readable set
criteria.action: refuse, and when a bound PAT's binding causes the refusal, report it once through wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace with wsaccess.SiteOf(c, 404)
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"}

criteria.condition: an admin token requests GET /audit
criteria.action: query without a workspace restriction, as today
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 including hub events with an empty workspace

criteria.action: for any non-admin caller and any seeded events, return from GET /audit only events whose workspace is non-empty and in the caller's readable set

requirements.title: SSE event stream
requirements.rationale: Members follow their org's workspaces live with the same set the unified query uses.

criteria.condition: a non-admin caller holding audit:read opens GET /events
criteria.action: compute the readable set once from wsaccess.ReadableSlugs before registering the connection, and deliver only events whose workspace is in that set
criteria.contract: events of owned and member workspaces arrive on the stream

criteria.condition: a non-admin SSE connection is open
criteria.guard: the caller's org membership is added or removed after the connection opened
criteria.action: keep filtering by the readable set computed at connect until the connection closes

criteria.condition: GET /events carries a workspace filter naming a workspace outside the caller's readable set
criteria.action: refuse before writing any stream header and without registering a connection
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"}; no text/event-stream header

criteria.action: deliver events with an empty workspace only to connections opened by an admin token

requirements.title: Opening a session
requirements.rationale: Opening a session is a write and stays with the owner and admin tokens; replaying an existing id is a read.

criteria.condition: W's owner or an admin token holding sessions:write submits POST /sessions with workspace_slug W
criteria.action: decide access through a write helper that calls wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.SiteOf(c, 404)) and then wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(db, auth, W, wsaccess.NeedWrite), without checking W's status, and create the session as today
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with the created session for a new id

criteria.condition: a member of W's org submits POST /sessions with workspace_slug W
criteria.action: refuse and write no session row
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with body {error: "org members have read-only access to this workspace", error_type: "forbidden"}; session row count unchanged

criteria.condition: a stranger submits POST /sessions with workspace_slug W, or W names no workspace
criteria.action: refuse and write no session row
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"}; session row count unchanged

criteria.condition: POST /sessions passes the write check and names an existing session id whose session belongs to another workspace W2
criteria.guard: the caller is W2's owner or a member of W2's org
criteria.action: return the existing session, deciding through wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(db, auth, W2, wsaccess.NeedRead)
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the existing session record

criteria.condition: POST /sessions names an existing session id whose session belongs to another workspace W2 that the caller may not read
criteria.action: refuse without disclosing the session
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"}

requirements.title: Writes that do not change
requirements.rationale: Completing sessions, reporting usage and ingesting audit data keep their published answers, which already refuse members.

criteria.condition: a member of W's org submits POST /sessions/:id/complete or POST /sessions/:id/usage for a session another user opened in W
criteria.action: refuse with the unchanged session-creator check and change no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with body {error: "not session owner"}; session and usage rows unchanged

criteria.condition: a member of W's org submits any ingestion route for active workspace W
criteria.action: refuse through the unchanged checkWorkspaceAccess and write no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with error_type workspace_access_denied; audit row count unchanged

criteria.action: keep checkWorkspaceAccess's order for every caller, members included: missing workspace 404, binding 404, archived 409 workspace_archived, then non-owner 403 workspace_access_denied
criteria.contract: a member on an archived W receives HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_archived

requirements.title: Bound tokens and refusal reports
requirements.rationale: Spec 33 confinement and spec 34 reporting must answer exactly as today whether the token's user is an owner or a member.

criteria.condition: a bound PAT requests a per-run read route, a session read route or GET /audit for its bound workspace W
criteria.guard: the token's user is a member of W's org
criteria.action: grant access as for an unbound member of W
criteria.contract: HTTP 200

criteria.condition: a bound PAT names a workspace other than its bound workspace on a route of this spec
criteria.action: refuse with the route's usual refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 {error: "workspace not found"} on per-run reads, the transcript, POST /sessions and the GET /audit workspace filter; HTTP 403 {error: "workspace access denied"} on session read routes

criteria.action: produce exactly one refusal report for each request refused because of a binding, carrying the request's method, its route template (for example /api/v1/sessions/:id) and the status answered, whether the requested slug exists, is readable or neither
criteria.contract: the bound-refusal observer is called once per refused request with {TokenID, UserID, BoundSlug, RequestedSlug, Method, Route, Status, Surface: api}

criteria.action: produce no refusal report when a bound PAT's GET /sessions, GET /audit or GET /events is filtered to its bound workspace without a workspace filter outside it
criteria.contract: the bound-refusal observer is called 0 times

requirements.title: Failures fail closed
requirements.rationale: A database error while deciding access must never grant access, and each route keeps its existing refusal shape.

criteria.condition: reading the workspace, the org membership or the token binding fails while deciding access on a per-run read route, the transcript or POST /sessions
criteria.action: refuse, return no audit data and write no session row
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with body {error: "internal server error"}

criteria.condition: reading the workspace, the org membership or the token binding fails while deciding access on a session read route or the session list
criteria.action: refuse and return no session data
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 with body {error: "workspace access denied"} on session read routes; GET /sessions without workspace_slug returns no session

criteria.condition: wsaccess.ReadableSlugs or the binding lookup fails on GET /audit
criteria.action: refuse and return no events
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with body {error: "internal server error"}

criteria.condition: wsaccess.ReadableSlugs or the binding lookup fails on GET /events
criteria.action: refuse before writing any stream header and without registering a connection
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with body {error: "internal server error"}; no text/event-stream header

requirements.title: Compatibility and the single rule
requirements.rationale: Existing owners, strangers and tests see no change, and every audit read decision lives in wsaccess.

criteria.action: for any stranger to workspace W and any route of this spec, answer with the same status and error body as before this spec
criteria.contract: per-run reads, the transcript, POST /sessions and the GET /audit workspace filter answer HTTP 404 {error: "workspace not found"}; session read routes answer HTTP 403 {error: "workspace access denied"}; ingestion answers HTTP 403 workspace_access_denied

criteria.action: for any workspace in a personal org whose only member is its owner, or with a NULL org_id, answer every request on the routes of this spec with the same status and body as before this spec

make no read decision in internal/audit by comparing owner_id with the caller: requireWorkspaceRead and hasWorkspaceAccess decide through wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace with wsaccess.NeedRead, readableWorkspaces and getAccessibleWorkspaces derive their sets from wsaccess.ReadableSlugs, and ownedWorkspaces no longer exists
criteria.contract: a source scan of internal/audit's non-test files finds no ownedWorkspaces declaration and no owner_id query outside checkWorkspaceAccess

criteria.action: give openTestSQLiteDB in internal/audit/testhelpers_test.go a workspaces table with org_id and clone_status columns and an org_members(org_id, user_id) table, so every existing internal/audit test passes with no assertion changed
criteria.contract: go test ./internal/audit/... passes

execution_paths.title: An org member reads a teammate's workspace sessions, cost and run audit

steps.action: sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/W/runs/R/events with a PAT holding audit:read
checks the binding with wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace and calls wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(W, NeedRead), which reads W's org_id and finds U2 in org_members
sends GET /api/v1/sessions?workspace_slug=W and GET /api/v1/workspaces/W/cost with sessions:read
admits U2 through hasWorkspaceAccess because W is active and readable, and returns 200 with W's sessions and cost

execution_paths.title: An org member sees the workspace in the unified audit query and the live stream

steps.action: computes U2's readable set once with wsaccess.ReadableSlugs (owned plus member workspaces)
returns 200 with events of W and of U2's own workspaces, and no hub event with an empty workspace
publishes an event for workspace W
delivers the event to U2's open connection

execution_paths.title: An org member tries to change the workspace and is refused

steps.action: calls wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(W, NeedWrite), which refuses a member, and writes no session row
sends POST /api/v1/sessions/S/complete for owner U1's session S
returns 403 not session owner and leaves session S unchanged

symbols.signature: func AuthorizeWorkspace(db *sql.DB, auth *apikit.AuthInfo, slug string, need Need) (*WorkspaceAccess, int, string)
symbols.notes: Per 35-REQ-2: AccessNone or unknown slug gives (nil, 404, "workspace not found") with no report; member with NeedWrite gives (nil, 403, "org members have read-only access to this workspace"); DB error gives (nil, 500, "internal server error").
